cards.answer: Rengar is an AD-focused assassin and fighter who leaps from brush or camouflage to attack enemies. Ferocity empowers his basic abilities.
cards.counterplay: Keep your distance from brush and stay near allies when he hunts.

cards.answer: Unseen Predator lets Rengar leap to attack targets from brush. Basic abilities build Ferocity; at maximum Ferocity, his next basic ability is empowered and briefly grants movement speed. Unique enemy champion takedowns grant permanent trophies that increase his attack damage.
cards.counterplay: Avoid fighting beside brush and respect his empowered ability when Ferocity is full.

cards.answer: Savagery resets Rengar's attack timer and makes his next attack deal bonus physical damage. It also grants attack speed; the Ferocity version increases damage and grants additional attack speed.
cards.counterplay: Create distance after his leap to limit follow-up attacks.

cards.answer: Battle Roar deals magic damage to nearby enemies and heals Rengar based on damage he recently took. The Ferocity version also cleanses crowd control. Casting the normal and empowered versions in quick succession can repeat the healing from recent damage.
cards.counterplay: Hold follow-up crowd control until his empowered roar is spent, and account for healing before committing.

facts.claim: Casting the normal and empowered versions in quick succession can repeat the healing from recent damage.

cards.priority_reason: Healing and the empowered cleanse can reverse a burst or crowd-control attempt.

cards.answer: Bola Strike is a projectile that deals physical damage to the first enemy hit, briefly slowing and revealing them. The Ferocity version roots the target instead of slowing them.
cards.counterplay: Sidestep the bola or use minions as cover, especially when his Ferocity is full.

cards.answer: Thrill of the Hunt grants movement speed, then camouflage after a delay, allowing Rengar to leap without brush. It reveals the nearest enemy champion in range and marks the nearest detected enemy as he approaches. Leaping to the marked enemy deals bonus physical damage and then reduces their armor.
cards.counterplay: Stay near allies during his hunt and prepare to peel when he leaps.
